blocks.text:
Step 1: Get BOM Details and Production Method Derivation Type based on ItemClasses
Query V_BRD_UPI_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_LOCATION_CORE_PIT to  retrieve BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ID as BOMNUM, PARENT_ITEM_ID AS ITEM, PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM AS ITEM_CLASS_NM, PARENT_ITEM_PLANT_CD  AS LOC
inner join with metadata on ITEM_CLASS_NM in ColumnValueOneTxt where SubjectAreaNm = "ProductionMethod", EntityNm = "ProductionMethod", BusinessRuleNm in ( ProductionMethod_Config) and get ColumnVauleTwoTxt as PMDerivationType
Join with V_BRD_ITEM_MATERIAL_CORE_PIT on item_id and MATERIAL_TYPE_CD NOT IN (UNBW) -- use metadata to  fetch this value ( to exclude bailed items)
Create an initial dataset:
| BOM# | Item | Loc | ItemClassNm | PMDerivationType
Step 2: Fetch Effective and Discontinue Dates - to determine the effectiveness range of an item - location pair
For each Item–Location pair, extract eff_ww (effective workweek) and disc_ww (discontinue workweek) using Production Method effectiveness UI  view/table (V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_EFFECTIVITY_CORE_PIT)
where eff_ww is null set to default using metadata and disc_ww as null
Update main dataset to include:
| BOM# | Item | Loc | ItemClass | PMDerivationType | eff_ww | disc_ww |
Step 3: Get Planning TPT by Work Week - to determine if an item - location pair falls under Timephasing or not
For every Item–Location pair, query V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_PV_OPR_WORKWEEK_CORE_PIT view to obtain Planning TPT values per Work Week (WW) where WW falls between eff_ww and disc_ww (inclusive).
For default eff_ww consider current ww and for disc_ww till the end
